records.text: Retry Sieve — Concept. Definition: a retry design rule that retries only requests without a terminal receipt and reuses the original idempotency key for every retry.

Hush Reference — Concept. Workshop transcript. Selin Varo reported: "Its definition is an acoustic baseline method that measures the empty chamber noise before testing a specimen and subtracts that baseline from the specimen trace."
